contea di ritrovamento: North East Lincolnshire (Inghilterra e Galles)

Copper alloy coin fragment. Nummus of the House of Constantine, Urbs Roma commemorative issue of 330-340, Reece period 17. Lyons mint, RIC vol. 7 page 138 no. 257, issue of 332. Half the flan lost. Obverse description: Bust of Roma left. Obverse inscription: VRBS [ROMA]. Reverse description: wolf suckling twins. In exergue: [crescent with dot] PLG. Diameter: 15.5mm, Weight: 0.88gms, die axis: 12
